# gl_test case 52 (es3split): the vertex attribute and buffer descriptors
# Mesa 26.2.1 packs for its draw (glDrawElementsInstanced(GL_TRIANGLES, 294,
# GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT, 0, 40 or 8); attribute 0 vec4 pos stride 16 per vertex,
# attribute 1 vec2 offs offset 0 and attribute 2 vec4 icol offset 8, both of
# one buffer with stride 24 and glVertexAttribDivisor 1). NOT a dump: no
# drm-shim was available (docs/notes/mali-frame-formats.md section 1). Derived
# from the source below and the vertex-rate descriptors of the board's dumps
# (0dce654a8:tools/mali/board-ref/2026-10-20-mesa-refs/mesa/mesa-uniidxi.pandecode lines
# 98-112, 117-120); the three per-instance values marked (?) are exactly what
# the board Mesa reference (mode instsplit) must confirm.
#
# Source: pan_cmdstream.c:4083-4117 panfrost_pack_attribute (CSO create),
#         pan_cmdstream.c:941-971 panfrost_emit_vertex_buffers (draw),
#         pan_csf.c:1706 INSTANCE_COUNT = info->instance_count.
#
# Attribute (pandecode field names; src/mali Attribute fields in brackets)
#   field               attr 0 (vertex)   attr 1 (instance)   attr 2 (instance)
#   Attribute type      1D                1D POT Divisor (?)  1D POT Divisor (?)   [attribute_type]
#   Offset enable       true              false (?)           false (?)            [offset_enable]
#   Format (v7)         RGBA32F RGBA      RG32F RGB1          RGBA32F RGBA         [format]
#   Table               2                 2                   2                    [table]
#   Frequency           Vertex            Instance            Instance             [frequency]
#   Divisor R           0                 0 (ctz(1))          0                    [divisor_r]
#   Divisor E           0                 0                   0                    [divisor_e]
#   Offset              0                 0                   8                    [offset]
#   Buffer index        vertex buffer     vertex buffer       vertex buffer        [buffer_index]
#   Stride              16                24                  24                   [stride]
#   Divisor D           0                 0                   0                    [divisor_d]
# Buffer: Address = buffer base + buffer_offset, Size = width0 - buffer_offset
#   (verts 8*8*16 = 1024 bytes; instance data 40*24 = 960 bytes).
# Mesa's divisor 1 is a power of two, so POT (divisor_r = ctz(divisor)); any
# other divisor is 1D NPOT Divisor with divisor_d from pan_compute_npot_divisor
# (pan_cmdstream.c:4108-4115), which the Mali table does not need
# (YakoglBackend.max_instance_divisor 0 means divisor 1 only).
# Offset enable is true only for a per-vertex attribute (:4098-4102); whether
# the hardware reads Offset (8, attribute 2) with it false is the (?) the
# board dump settles.
# Draw: IDVS INSTANCE_COUNT (r34 in src/mali frame.rs reg::INSTANCE_COUNT) = 40;
#   the draw is indexed (u16, 294 indices), VERTEX_OFFSET 0.
